content:
I've added two new phases to the TauCetiProject/TauCetiWorker example worker, tauceti overlap-scan and tauceti overlap-fix.

The first of these updates a cursor into Mathlib's master history, and reads new changes to Mathlib, to identify any newly landing material that overlaps with Tau Ceti, and opens issues at Tau Ceti requesting appropriate deletions/refactors. The second of these then acts on these issues and opens PRs.

This should help us keep to our promise to always defer to Mathlib, and refactor as needed to use Mathlib's versions.

You can see two examples in action at

  • TauCeti#15246 closed by TauCeti#15267
  • TauCeti#15269, being closed by TauCeti#15673

So we have mathlib being a submodule, and a separate cursor?
Why not just use the mathlib submodule commit as the cursor itself? Seems simpler, if the framework is there.

I want to separate them, so that the work of fixing Tau Ceti to work on a newer mathlib can be done separately from the work of ripping out overlaps. Both of these are potentially large jobs, and the system is hopefully more robust if they aren't tied together (admittedly there is the tradeoff of the additional complexity).

Could I ask someone to add both overlap-scan and overlap-fix to one of their long running workers? (I accidentally removed mine, and we fell behind a few days. Happily my "what's on fire" monitor caught this.)
